---
title: "统一冻结日历：JOINT 与刚性 Top2 完整重放"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  cache: false
  freeze: false
  error: false
params:
  drawdown: null
  drawdown_receipt_sha256: null
  baseline: null
  baseline_receipt_sha256: null
  study: null
  output: null
  labels: null
  python: null
  receipt_sha256: null
---

本轮不新增拟合：继承上一轮每10期更新、截止前历史冻结的HANDICAP 概率版本。
规则已声明为原权重、第三赛果50%折扣转给原第二赛果、刚性Top2。
折扣/上限释放的权重转给原第二赛果；这些是购买权重，不冒充已经校准的概率。
原概率、赛前估算价格、原组与票数不变，不重新执行改变后25%覆盖准入。
所有规则票先冻结，再开封目标结算；本研究窗口和参数属于回顾探索，不能视为未见样本证明。

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(dplyr);library(tidyr);library(readr);library(ggplot2)})
stopifnot(!is.null(params$study),!is.null(params$output),!is.null(params$python),!is.null(params$labels))
reticulate::use_python(params$python,required=TRUE)
files<-c('r/diagnostic_verified_csv.R','r/diagnostic_verified_rds.R','r/n7_joint_sleeves.R','r/third_outcome_tickets.R',
 'r/fundamentals_equity_curves.R','r/n7_baseline_comparison.R','quarto/182_joint_top2_uniform.qmd','config/top2_outside_validation.json')
for(n in files[grepl('[.]R$',files)])source(n)
code<-setNames(as.list(vapply(files,digest::digest,character(1),file=TRUE,algo='sha256')),files)
s<-params$study;o<-params$output;stopifnot(!dir.exists(o),dir.create(o,recursive=FALSE))
pb<-readBin(file.path(s,'plans-receipt.json'),'raw',n=file.info(file.path(s,'plans-receipt.json'))$size)
stopifnot(digest::digest(pb,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==params$receipt_sha256)
parent<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(pb),simplifyVector=FALSE)
for(n in names(parent$implementation))stopifnot(digest::digest(file=n,algo='sha256')==parent$implementation[[n]])
vb<-readBin(file.path(s,'independent-replay.json'),'raw',n=file.info(file.path(s,'independent-replay.json'))$size)
validation<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(vb))
stopifnot(validation$status=='PASS',validation$allocations==length(parent$scope)*4)
if(!identical(validation$plans_receipt_sha256,params$receipt_sha256))stop('Parent replay receipt identity mismatch')
validation_sha256<-digest::digest(vb,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')
cfg<-jsonlite::fromJSON('config/top2_outside_validation.json');cfg$rules<-cfg$fixed_rules |> filter(id %in% c('ORIGINAL','HARD'))
stopifnot(identical(unlist(parent$scope),cfg$issues))
core<-reticulate::import('src.temporal_learning.core')
prov<-reticulate::import('src.temporal_learning.provenance');pathlib<-reticulate::import('pathlib')
closure<-prov$implementation_closure(pathlib$Path(getwd()),as.list('src.fundamentals_n7_baseline'),distributions=c('numpy','pandas'))
db<-readBin(file.path(params$drawdown,'receipt.json'),'raw',n=file.info(file.path(params$drawdown,'receipt.json'))$size)
stopifnot(digest::digest(db,serialize=FALSE,algo='sha256')==params$drawdown_receipt_sha256)
ddr<-jsonlite::fromJSON(rawToChar(db),simplifyVector=FALSE)
stopifnot(ddr$parent_models_sha256==parent$model_sha256)
inputs<-Filter(function(b)b$arm=='HANDICAP_PROB',parent$bindings)
for(i in seq_along(inputs))inputs[[i]]$root<-s
for(b in ddr$bindings)if(b$rule=='NEW_RULE') {
 inputs[[length(inputs)+1L]]<-list(issue=b$issue,arm='HANDICAP_PROB',root=params$drawdown,
 replay=b$path,replay_sha256=b$sha256,fit_model_seal=b$model_seal,cache_key=b$sha256)
}
ids<-sort(c(cfg$issues,cfg$excluded_drawdown_issues));stopifnot(length(ids)==484,!anyDuplicated(ids),
 setequal(vapply(inputs,`[[`,character(1),'issue'),ids),length(inputs)==484)
inputs<-inputs[order(vapply(inputs,`[[`,character(1),'issue'))]
models<-diagnostic_read_verified_rds(file.path(s,'frozen-models.rds'),parent$model_sha256)
stopifnot(length(models)==49)
bindings<-list();counter<-0
for(b in inputs) {
 block<-1L+(match(b$issue,ids)-1L)%/%10L
 stopifnot(identical(b$fit_model_seal,models[[block]]$seal))
 path<-file.path(b$root,b$replay)
 x<-diagnostic_read_verified_rds(path,b$replay_sha256);selected<-x$result$pool$options[x$result$fit$selected]
 funded<-tibble(sleeve_id=vapply(selected,function(z)as.character(z$sleeve_id),character(1)),
  depth=vapply(selected,function(z)as.integer(z$depth),integer(1)))
 plan<-third_outcome_ticket_plan(x$fixtures,x$result$surface,funded,x$cutoffs,params$python,
  cfg$rules,cfg$unit_cny,cfg$payout_factor,cfg$budget_cny)
 model<-sub('_PROB$','',b$arm);name<-paste0('plan-',b$issue,'-',model,'.rds')
 saveRDS(plan,file.path(o,name))
 bindings[[paste(b$issue,model)]]<-list(issue=b$issue,model=model,plan=name,
  sha256=digest::digest(file=file.path(o,name),algo='sha256'),source=file.path(b$root,b$replay),source_sha256=b$replay_sha256,
  inherited_fit_seal=b$fit_model_seal,cutoffs=x$cutoffs,
  cache_key=core$stable_json_hash(list(cutoffs=x$cutoffs,parent=b$cache_key,rules_sha256=code[['config/top2_outside_validation.json']],
   implementation=code,python=closure$closure_sha256)))
 counter<-counter+1;writeLines(as.character(counter),file.path(o,'progress.txt'))
}
stopifnot(counter==length(ids),identical(code,setNames(as.list(vapply(files,digest::digest,character(1),file=TRUE,algo='sha256')),files)))
receipt<-list(scope=ids,drawdown_receipt=params$drawdown_receipt_sha256,parent_receipt=params$receipt_sha256,parent_replay_sha256=validation_sha256,code=code,python=closure,
 config=cfg,bindings=bindings,labels_sha256=parent$sources$fixture_audit,historical_admission=FALSE)
jsonlite::write_json(receipt,file.path(o,'plans-receipt.json'),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)
```

## 冻结后结算

```{r}
labels<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(params$labels,receipt$labels_sha256,cols(issue='c',provider_id='c')) |>
 select(issue,slot,provider_id,handicap,actual_direction,spf_sp)
groups<-members<-list()
for(b in bindings) {
 path<-file.path(o,b$plan)
 plan<-diagnostic_read_verified_rds(path,b$sha256)
 groups[[length(groups)+1L]]<-third_outcome_ticket_settle(plan,labels) |> mutate(model=b$model)
 members[[length(members)+1L]]<-plan$members |> mutate(model=b$model)
}
groups<-bind_rows(groups);members<-bind_rows(members)
stopifnot(nrow(anti_join(members,labels,by=c('issue','slot','provider_id','handicap')))==0)
members<-members |> left_join(labels,by=c('issue','slot','provider_id','handicap'),relationship='many-to-one') |>
 mutate(third_hit=actual_direction==third)
rows<-groups |> group_by(issue,model,rule) |> summarise(stake=sum(stake),gross=sum(gross),
 expected_gross=sum(expected_gross),estimated_actual_gross=sum(ifelse(hit,estimated_actual_gross,0)),
 hits=sum(hit),bought_groups=n(),third_tickets=sum(third_tickets),.groups='drop')
rows<-expand_grid(issue=ids,model=cfg$models,rule=cfg$rules$id) |>
 left_join(rows,by=c('issue','model','rule'),relationship='one-to-one') |>
 mutate(across(c(stake,gross,expected_gross,estimated_actual_gross,hits,bought_groups,third_tickets),~replace_na(.x,0)),
 net=gross-stake,budget_cny=cfg$budget_cny,cash_cny=budget_cny-stake,
 status=ifelse(stake>0,'COMPLETE','NO_BET'),policy=paste(model,rule,sep='_'))
curves<-strategy_equity_curves(rows,ids,cfg$initial_capital_cny);stopifnot(!any(curves$stopped))
summary<-curves |> filter(period>0) |> group_by(model,policy) |>
 summarise(stake=sum(funded_stake_cny),net=sum(funded_net_cny),roi=if(stake>0)net/stake else NA_real_,
 hit_issues=sum(gross>0),profit_issues=sum(funded_net_cny>0),max_drawdown=max(drawdown_cny),
 minimum_equity=min(cfg$initial_capital_cny,equity_cny),cash=sum(cash_cny),
 net_excluding_best=sum(funded_net_cny)-max(funded_net_cny),.groups='drop')
for(n in c('groups','members','rows','curves','summary'))write_csv(get(n),file.path(o,paste0(n,'.csv')))
knitr::kable(summary,digits=3)
p<-curves |> mutate(rule=sub('^[^_]+_','',policy)) |>
 select(model,rule,period,equity_cny,drawdown_cny) |>
 pivot_longer(c(equity_cny,drawdown_cny),names_to='metric',values_to='CNY') |>
 ggplot(aes(period,CNY,color=rule))+geom_line()+facet_grid(metric~model,scales='free_y')+
 theme_minimal()+labs(x='Issue index',color='Purchase rule')
print(p);ggsave(file.path(o,'equity-drawdown.png'),p,width=14,height=8,dpi=150)
```

汇总的收益并不证明调整后权重是真实概率；真实覆盖仍按输入冻结概率计算。
完整诊断需结合第三赛果挤占、回款桥接、期内集中和独立重放验收。

## 统一账本比较

旧 JOINT 保持旧冻结概率；Top2 全部484期继承同一49块HANDICAP模型日历，不使用此前94期独立研究的模型。
同时展示同日历HANDICAP原概率购票作为控制。每期均重新生成ORIGINAL与HARD票单，冻结后统一结算。
前10期为HANDICAP预热，不拼接替代曲线。标签可用性为历史代理，本报告不宣称前瞻有效性。

```{r}
source('r/n7_baseline_comparison.R')
brpath<-file.path(params$baseline,'receipt.json')
stopifnot(digest::digest(file=brpath,algo='sha256')==params$baseline_receipt_sha256)
br<-jsonlite::fromJSON(brpath,simplifyVector=FALSE)
oldrows<-diagnostic_read_verified_csv(file.path(params$baseline,'rows.csv'),br$files[['rows.csv']],cols(issue='c'))
control<-oldrows |> filter(policy=='B_NEW_OLD') |> select(issue,stake,gross)
check<-rows |> filter(rule=='ORIGINAL') |> select(issue,stake,gross) |>
 inner_join(control,by='issue',suffix=c('_run','_control'),relationship='one-to-one')
stopifnot(nrow(check)==484,all(check$stake_run==check$stake_control),max(abs(check$gross_run-check$gross_control))<1e-6)
combined<-bind_rows(oldrows |> filter(policy=='A_OLD_OLD') |> transmute(issue,policy='OLD_JOINT',model='FROZEN',stake,gross,net,hits),
 rows |> transmute(issue,policy=ifelse(rule=='HARD','UNIFORM_TOP2','UNIFORM_PROB'),model='HANDICAP',stake,gross,net,hits)) |>
 mutate(stage=case_when(issue<min(cfg$excluded_drawdown_issues)~'BEFORE_305',issue %in% cfg$excluded_drawdown_issues~'DRAWDOWN_94',TRUE~'AFTER_85'),
 budget_cny=cfg$budget_cny,cash_cny=budget_cny-stake,status=ifelse(stake>0,'COMPLETE','NO_BET'))
comparison<-n7_baseline_comparison(combined,ids,c('BEFORE_305','DRAWDOWN_94','AFTER_85'),'OLD_JOINT',cfg$initial_capital_cny)
write_csv(combined,file.path(o,'comparison-rows.csv'));write_csv(comparison$summary,file.path(o,'comparison-summary.csv'))
write_csv(comparison$curves,file.path(o,'comparison-curves.csv'))
knitr::kable(comparison$summary,digits=2)
plotrows<-comparison$curves |> filter(evaluation=='ALL',policy!='UNIFORM_PROB') |>
 select(policy,period,equity_cny,drawdown_cny) |> pivot_longer(c(equity_cny,drawdown_cny),names_to='metric',values_to='CNY')
fig<-ggplot(plotrows,aes(period,CNY,color=policy))+annotate('rect',xmin=305.5,xmax=399.5,ymin=-Inf,ymax=Inf,fill='orange',alpha=.10)+
 geom_line(linewidth=.6)+facet_wrap(~metric,ncol=1,scales='free_y')+theme_minimal()+
 labs(title='Old JOINT vs uniform-calendar hard Top2',subtitle='484 issues; CNY 100,000 initial capital; CNY 1,024 budget cap; one 0.65 payout factor',x='Issue sequence; shaded: 94-issue drawdown window',color=NULL,y='CNY',caption='Top2 uses one 49-block freeze calendar throughout. Historical diagnostic; no spliced drawdown models.')
print(fig);ggsave(file.path(o,'joint-top2-uniform.png'),fig,width=12,height=8,dpi=160)
artifacts<-list.files(o,pattern='[.](csv|png|rds)$',full.names=TRUE)
jsonlite::write_json(list(status='REPLAYED_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW',historical_admission=FALSE,
 parent_receipt=params$receipt_sha256,drawdown_receipt=params$drawdown_receipt_sha256,baseline_receipt=params$baseline_receipt_sha256,
 scope=ids,implementation=c(code,list(comparison=digest::digest(file='r/n7_baseline_comparison.R',algo='sha256'))),
 files=setNames(as.list(vapply(artifacts,digest::digest,character(1),file=TRUE,algo='sha256')),basename(artifacts))),file.path(o,'report-receipt.json'),auto_unbox=TRUE,pretty=TRUE)
```
